in_marathi.name: Premraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine Love, Precious One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Premraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prem means divine love and Raj means king, ruler or precious one. This name signifies a person who is deeply in love and holds a royal status or a precious value in someone's life.
